Package io.goobi.viewer.managedbeans

Class TermBrowseBean

java.lang.Object
io.goobi.viewer.managedbeans.TermBrowseBean
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
@Named @SessionScoped public class TermBrowseBean extends Object implements Serializable
This bean provides the data for alphabetical term browsing (the browsing menu). Collection browsing is handled by CollectionBrowseBean.
